templates.title: Sit
templates.goal: Develop a calm, voluntary sit routine suitable for dog.

lessons.title: Prepare a calm setup
steps: Choose a quiet, secure and species-appropriate setting for sit.
Select a reward the pet willingly accepts; check for pain, stress or reluctance.
Keep the task optional and allow the pet to leave.

successCriteria.description: Pet voluntarily engages with the setup while relaxed; no fixed number of repetitions.

lessons.title: Introduce the behavior
steps: Reward a naturally offered sit
Add the cue only when sitting is predictable
Mark and reward small successful approximations; reduce difficulty if the pet hesitates.

successCriteria.description: Pet voluntarily demonstrates an early component of sit without distress.

lessons.title: Build reliable participation
steps: Ask once on a non-slip surface and reward promptly
Vary only one factor at a time (duration, distance, environment, or distraction).
Finish after an easy success and record what was comfortable.

successCriteria.description: Pet performs the trained sit behavior calmly in a familiar context on more than one occasion; no scientifically established numeric threshold is claimed.

lessons.title: Generalize and maintain
steps: Revisit the skill on another day in an equally safe, familiar setting.
Gradually vary context only if the pet remains relaxed.
Return to an easier step after missed responses, avoidance, or stress.

successCriteria.description: Voluntary performance remains comfortable across appropriate sessions and settings.

safetyNotes: Use voluntary, reward-based methods; never punish or force the behavior.
Stop at signs of distress, avoidance, or fatigue.
Adapt all practice to the species and individual.
Do not use punishment, flooding, forced restraint, or aversive equipment.

references.limitations: Supports general training approach, not this exact lesson sequence, session duration or mastery criterion.
Does not establish exact app lesson sequence or universal mastery threshold.
Does not establish exact app lesson sequence or universal mastery threshold.

templates.summary: Build sit through voluntary, low-stress practice, progressing only while the pet remains comfortable.

duration.evidenceBasis: Dogs Trust general guidance: 5–10 minute training sessions. Not a hard cap.
